QuestInfo.name: Tyrant Trasher
QuestInfo.1: Find the person who defeated Magnus, the tyrant of Grandis. #bMake a party with a player who is wearing at least one Tyrant equipment: cape, belt, and/or shoes#k.\r\n#b<<Tyrant global set does not count>>\r\n#r<<To clear this mission you must make a party with a player on the same screen as you.>>#k

1.0: Ooh, you found the warrior of the dragon race! Your membership in the party proves it all. I'll give you a gift!
